report.answer_text:
In 2025, the two countries reported 52 wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) cases in total. Afghanistan reported 21 and Pakistan reported 31.[1] These are the latest WHO figures, from the November 2026 Polio IHR Emergency Committee statement.
Earlier reports gave lower numbers. For example, a December 2025 report put the total at 39 (9 in Afghanistan and 30 in Pakistan). The count rose later, partly because 11 of Afghanistan's 14 newly reported cases had paralysis onset in 2025[2].
For comparison, in 2024 Afghanistan recorded 25 cases and Pakistan 74.[3]
